asks.description: The question the layer asks, one sentence.
What the point is about, one sentence.

requires.description: What a project brings to take part, one line each. Name the side ("Both apps:", "Issuing side:") when the sides differ. A project's status at the point says how far it meets these.

done.description: What has to happen between two projects for the point to count as shown. A scenario is a recipe for exactly this; a passing result is the proof.

origin.description: Where the point comes from: a deck, a one-pager, a task force, a project.

weaveLevel.description: The level in the Project Weave deck, if the point comes from there.

derivedFrom.description: How the build fills a project's status at this point from its detail fields when the project has not said more than potential: an entry of `field` with status runs that matches every key in `match` makes the point runs (derived), with that entry's evidence.

match.description: Key of the entry → accepted values. A string value must be one of them; an array value must contain one of them.

candidate.description: An open question about the point itself: a proposal to merge it into another point or to drop it, with the reason. Removed when decided.

shown.description: One sentence on how the board derives that a point is shown between two projects.
